notes.title: Update 3.0.1
notes.content:
A few bug fixes to be up to date with the newly released Xbox version:
- Planet rings hidden when customizing stat values
- Fixed YouTube and TikTok links

notes.title: Full Release OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The full release update includes:
- 22 new campaign missions (total of 64)
- 4 different endings depending on relic and goal time progress
- 8 new achievements
- 3 new skins

Additional updates:
- Improved throwing AI and moved relic slightly in "Nuclear Propulsion"
- Adjusted description of many chapter 3 missions
- Adjusted splash screen
- Moved feedback survey to information submenu
- Emotes are disabled after entering a black hole

notes.title: Update 2.2.3
notes.content:
Balance and hints for chapter 2.

Worm Howling (biggest change)
- Moved wormholes closer
- Wormholes auto release grabbed bombs
- Reduced number of asteroids

Proxima c
- Added arrows to the starting text
- Adjusted description

Thinking With Portals
- Fixed typo in description

Galactic Gauntlet
- Reduced AI difficulty
- Hint to drain the star

Portal Pigsty
- Hint to grab the star while teleporting

Asteroid Vacuum
- You can grab the wormhole infinitely

Planets To Self Destruct
- Orbit angle less steep when close to the black hole

Singulari Trap
- Adjusted description

Misc
- Added hints to unlock new characters on every pick character mission
- Added Noom to beta tester credits

notes.title: Update 2.2.2
notes.content:
- Chapter relic and goal time percentages moved next to the chapter name in mission select
In-game text:
- "You Died" text only appears next to the controlled player
- Goal player marked in cargo missions
Button prompts:
- Less frequent button prompts
- Button prompts don't show on chapter 2 and 3 of the campaign
- Fixed spin break prompt
Quantum planet fixes (chapter 3):
- Each planet marked as "You"
- Fixed tap spin
- Fixed camera logic
- Fixed trickshot achievement
Misc:
- Show game version on ending screen
- Moved starting text position in "Little Maneuver"

notes.title: Update 2.2.1
notes.content:
- [Fix] Controls settings work for single player
- [Fix] Improved performance for controller rumble
- Updated to Unity 6 (shouldn't make much difference but this is the reason for the large update size)
- Adjusted player health, positions and enabled grab recovery in the "Leech Health" tutorial

notes.title: Update 2.2.0
notes.content:
Removed counter spin. This mechanic caused universal confusion. It no longer really matters which way you spin when grabbed.
- Spinning while grabbing no longer has an effect on grab time
- Adjusted "Breakout Spin" tutorial
- Changed "Counter Spin" tutorial to "Leech Health"
- Adjusted "Gas Leech" mission
- Spin rings always glow white at maximum spin speed
- Adjusted text describing spin

AI adjusted
- Fix: AI can release grab while grabbed
- Reduced chance for AI to parry
- Reduced chance AI will grab your planet
- Fix: AI no longer more likely to perform an action immediately when made available after not doing it for a while

Misc
- Extra tips in the tutorial select menu
- Prevents mission select movement in the first 0.5 seconds of spawn
- Fix: Holding the brake button during a scene transition activates brake

notes.title: Full Release on Nov 23!
notes.content:
Sumorbit will transition from early access to full release on November 23! There will be a 40% launch discount. Chapter 3 of the campaign will be included in the full release.

notes.title: Chapter 3 Beta + Update 2.1.7
notes.content:
The beta for the third and final chapter is up. If you're willing to record your gameplay, join the [url=https://discord.gg/Mc78SG86dC]Discord[/url] and give yourself the Beta Test role.
- 22 new missions
- 4 different endings depending on progress
- 7 new achievements (won't trigger on Steam until after the beta)
- 3 new skins

2.1.7 updates:
- The final round music track does not loop
- Prevented low range planets reaching beyond maximum range during the starting countdown
- The star on "Hyperdrive" shows on the camera if close enough
- Fixed pressing the back button while holding a picker
- Fixed achievement trigger for completing chapter 2
- Reordered maps

notes.title: Update 2.1.6
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Ring bouncing while grabbed reduces grab time by one third rather than one half
- Reduced difficulty of AI in "Galactic Gauntlet"
- Adjusted stats of the green planet in "Galactic Gauntlet"
- Prevented the black hole singularity from moving

Visuals
- Consistent scale for static effects
- Fixed a bug where the ring would stay white after the sun dies on missions with no ring shrink
- "Tie" text at the end of tied matches

Menus
- Added a tip to conserve speed in "Hyperdrive"
- Renamed "Back to Lobby" to "Sumo Lobby"
- Removed "Reconnect Controller" text on the end screen
- Removed 0 FPS from frame rate options and always have a 60 FPS option

notes.title: Update 2.1.5
notes.content:
- Spinning in the wrong direction while grabbed is half effective rather than completely ineffective (for real this time). Spin tutorials and "Gas Leech" remain unchanged.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes AI spin was only 90% effective
- The default prompt for spinning on gamepad is spinning the left stick instead of pressing a button (to discourage the need for pressing bumpers and triggers at the same time)
- Renamed "Break Out" prompt to "Spin Break"

notes.title: Update 2.1.4
notes.content:
- The game pauses if an active controller disconnects
- Disconnecting a controller in a menu also disconnects the player

notes.title: Update 2.1.3
notes.content:
- Removed additional friction while in the accretion disc of black holes
- Fixed a bug where if one player grabs another and they both enter a wormhole on the same frame they would be teleported double distance
- Supernova explosion now gives knockback
- Fixed icons on gameplay demo text

notes.title: Update 2.1.2
notes.content: Fixed a softlock in the tutorials menu from changing missions while the controls submenu is open.

notes.title: Update 2.1.1
notes.content:
Feature:
- Option to reset best times for a mission
Adjustments:
- Spiral wormholes in "Portal Pass" that release grabbed objects on contact
- Easier goal time for "Planets To Self Destruct"
- Moving asteroids can go through wormholes
Fixes:
- AI doesn't use bounce on the outer ring on "Singulari Trap"
- Prevent emotes from showing after a black hole eats a planet
- Star ring color correct during starting countdown
- Bounce particles teleporting between rings fixed
- Fixed a bug from holding on to an asteroid when it explodes

notes.title: Update 2.1.0
notes.content:
Mechanics:
- Spinning while bouncing transfers some spin into the object you bounce (mainly effective for cargo)
- You can now easily pass your moon through the middle of your planet while grabbing

Multiplayer balance (to reduce the power of a health drain playstyle and reduce the importance of counter-spinning):
- Reduced health drain from grabs by one third
- Increased grab recovery time for high grip and decreased grab recovery time for low grip
- Made spinning in the incorrect direction as the grabbed player apply half spin breakout factor rather than none
- You can once again parry while stunned (instead, AI planets won't parry if stunned)
- Edge parry time reduced by a quarter rather than a half

Visuals:
- Spin rings turn gray if spin is ineffective, and white if effective in grab breaks

Mission adjustments:
- Jupiter can move in "Beyond the Belt" so you don't have to be as accurate
- Balanced spin tutorials and "Gas Leech" from health drain and spin changes
- Renamed "Cross the Stream" to "Rescue Phobos"
- Adjusted "Notched In" goal time for spin bouncing

Controls:
- Fixed IJKL moon movement
- Added semicolon for grab when using IJKL

notes.content:

Balance

notes.title: Update 1.4.3
notes.content:
- Added a setting to reduce particle effects to improve performance
- Fixed a bug where wormholes wouldn't function correctly on the Great Filter map if wormhole quality was set to zero

notes.title: Update 1.4.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where AI players wouldn't grab planets as much on maps and missions with bombs

notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where restarting a mission after completing it would go to the next mission

notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.content:
- Multiplayer has been renamed to "Sumo" and is now the top option under "Play game"
- New "Add players" menu as the top option under "Ready actions" in the Sumo lobby when only one player has joined
- "Quick reset speedrun" option under campaign settings. It adds the ability to reset progress on the current profile in the pause menu.
- "Next Mission" option in the campaign pause menu
- Fixed bugs related to moving to the next mission without going back to mission select
- Grabbing a player that ring bounces reduces maximum grab time by half rather than a full grab release
- Higher contrast for stat value selectors

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:

- Stopped AI from attempting to parry while grabbed

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
- Performance improvements
- Mars is more aggressive in "Conveyor of Doom" to make the relic challenge more consistent
- Fixed a bug where the save overwrite character preset option was sometimes unavailable
- Reduced file size

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
New map voting system for multiplayer:
- Each player can select a map they want to play on
- The game randomly picks from voted maps
- If no maps are voted, a random map is selected like normal

The Great Filter map has been adjusted to prevent chaotic death from entering wormholes at bad angles:
- Wormholes share a global timeout of 2 seconds once entered that doesn't pause
- The map has been made bigger
- Gaps between wormholes are larger so skilled players can more easily thread the gap for offense and survival

Misc:
- Added goal time hints for some missions

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where you could still bounce the ring after the sun dies
- New sun death sound effect
- Can always pause the game with escape, regardless of current player input devices
- Able to select restart mission from pause menu after dying
- Show keyboard controls next to resume and restart in pause menu
- Made tilde key prompt symbols smaller
- No prompt to move your moon while it is detached
- Updated "Out of Orbit" mission preview
- Updated "Pass On" mission description grammar

notes.title: Update 0.16.11

- Darkened grid color for relics
- "Race to the Sun" goal time reduced

notes.title: Early Access release on April 22!
notes.content:
Sumorbit releases in early access on April 22! (Earth Day)

It has polished local multiplayer and one single player campaign chapter with 21 missions.

Chapter 2 and 3 will be developed and released throughout 2024.

Learn more about early access plans on the Steam page. Wishlist the game to be notified when it comes out!
